        base = [3 ** (k-1-i) for i in range(k)]
        # precompute offset lists per subset of used positions
        cache = {}
        for key, count in self.pats[e].items():
            fixed = 0
            used = set()
            for position, value in key:

                used.add(position)
            mask = tuple(sorted(used))
            offsets = cache.get(mask)

                    offsets = [o + t*step for o in offsets for t in STATES]
                cache[mask] = offsets
            for off in offsets:
